title: A map from a reduced scheme factors through a closed subscheme exactly set-theoretically
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let i:Z\to X be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let Y be a reduced scheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. For a morphism f:Y\to X, f factors through i if and only if the set-theoretic image f(Y) is contained in i(Z). In particular, every morphism Y\to X factors through the reduction X_red\to X.
